## What this changes

One or two sentences: what it changes, and why. Link the issue if there is one.

## Before you submit

- [ ] **The CLA.** I have read the [Contributor License Agreement](https://github.com/nasbarok/desknode/blob/main/CLA.md). On a first pull request a bot comments with a link and a sentence to post; I post it once, and that one signature covers every pull request I open afterwards. The check stays red until then. That signature step has not yet been exercised by an outside contributor — see [Pull requests](https://github.com/nasbarok/desknode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
- [ ] **The license of the area I touched.** Firmware is GPL-3.0-or-later, the Windows agent is MIT, documentation is CC-BY-SA-4.0 — see [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/nasbarok/desknode/blob/main/LICENSING.md).
- [ ] **The code of conduct.** I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nasbarok/desknode/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## What I ran to check it

The commands, and what they printed — for example `bash tools/run_gates.sh`, a firmware build, a flash, the screen afterwards. "Nothing" is an acceptable answer, as long as it is written here.

---

Reviews happen when the maintainer has time, and no review date is promised: see [what this project is, honestly](https://github.com/nasbarok/desknode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-this-project-is-honestly).
